problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign packages to identical delivery trucks. Packages:
* Package Alpha: size 33 cubic feet
* Package Beta: size 65 cubic feet
* Package Gamma: size 30 cubic feet
* Package Delta: size 35 cubic feet
* Package Epsilon: size 55 cubic feet
* Package Zeta: size 70 cubic feet
* Package Eta: size 30 cubic feet
* Package Theta: size 69 cubic feet
* Package Iota: size 61 cubic feet
* Package Kappa: size 51 cubic feet

Each truck has a maximum capacity of 100 cubic feet. Assign all packages using the fewest trucks possible. Every package must be loaded onto exactly one truck, and the total volume in any truck cannot exceed its capacity limit.
